purpose: Test whether R4-1 CV-replicated structural analogy pairs occupy the same source-local functional slots in held-out documents, without assigning meanings or phonetic values.

cross_fitting.pair_scoring_documents: held-out documents of those selected folds only

context_parser.lexical_sign_context: opaque SHA256 token id identical to R4-0/R4-1
context_parser.numeric_context: retained as N:<FRAC|ONE|2_4|5_9|10PLUS|UNCERTAIN>, never a target
context_parser.nonlexical_source_piece: excluded from retained sequence using admitted typed-token policy

per_fold_tests.exact_shared_frame: same opaque left and right contexts occupied by both pair members
per_fold_tests.cross_document_exact_shared_frame: exact_shared_frame with at least one occurrence of each member in different held-out documents
per_fold_tests.typed_shared_frame: same left/right context types after lexical identities collapse to T while numeric buckets and boundaries remain distinct

primary_functional_substitution_gate.interpretation_if_positive: cross-fitted exact functional-slot substitution evidence for one or more structural analogy pairs
primary_functional_substitution_gate.interpretation_if_negative: no exact cross-fitted substitution-frame evidence at frozen threshold; broader distributional similarity remains descriptive only
